description: T-2339: the header a whole-column insert inside a table gives the new table column. Table Sales on S!B3:C7 (header B3:C3 Region/Qty, data rows 4-7 Qty 1,2,4,8); two insert_column ops each insert one column at C, between the two columns. Sheet F holds A1 =INDEX(Sales[#Headers],1,2) (the new column's header), A2 and A3 the header cells S!C3 and S!D3 read through INDIRECT, A4 COUNTA of Sales[Column1] and A5 ROWS of Sales[Column2] through INDIRECT (a #REF! if no such column), A6 =COLUMNS(Sales), A7 =SUM(Sales[Qty]), A8 =COLUMN(Sales[Qty]), A9 whether the new data cell S!C4 is blank, A10 the last header. The new header cells (S!C3, S!D3) are checked too. The oracle records formula cells only, so the header cells' expected text is Excel's as read through INDIRECT (F!A2 and F!A3, excel-graph 2026-10-27).
